subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Checklists for Testing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Checklists for Testing.

hook.text: Surgeons use checklists to avoid mistakes. Testers use them to avoid forgetting critical checks.

buildup.text: Test checklists are lightweight guides listing important areas to verify—not detailed scripts, just reminders.

discovery.text: They capture team knowledge: 'check timezone handling, test with empty database, verify email format.'

twist.text: Checklists become stale if not updated. They must evolve as the product changes and new bug patterns emerge.

climax.text: Atul Gawande's research shows checklists reduce errors 30–40% in surgery. The same applies to testing.

punchline.text: A checklist isn't bureaucracy. It's institutional memory.

quiz.question: Why must test checklists be updated regularly?
options: Because the product changes and new bug patterns emerge
